nodes.label: AC-01: Public enquiry saves source and owner; team tracks follow-up
nodes.rationale: SPEC §12. Email or phone required (not both); duplicate leads flagged and merged by Sales, never auto-merged; converted leads become read-only; enquiry form rate limited and bot checked.

nodes.label: AC-02: Subscription activates hotel discovery without exposing wedding modules
nodes.rationale: Subscription activates only purchased modules; wedding endpoints absent for subscriber-only accounts; expiry removes modules without deleting saved hotels/enquiries; renewal restores access (AC-02.11). Payment via Razorpay sandbox (V-1). Trial test dormant because the demo serves as the trial (Q3).

nodes.label: AC-03: Demo account cannot access records outside demo scope
nodes.rationale: Demo data lives in the same database behind flags; isolation tests prove no query path reaches non-demo rows (V-10). Demo content is three real hotels with indicative prices and masked rates, no expiry (AMPM 2026-10-26); demo assistance requests become Sales activities, not enquiries (P-7).

nodes.label: AC-04: Hotel search shows pricing freshness; unverified availability never confirmed
nodes.rationale: Verified vs stale labels; the word 'confirmed' never appears in rate context; availability is labelled separately from rates (no implied calendar).

nodes.label: AC-05: Negotiation and site visit recorded without exposing internal notes
nodes.rationale: Internal-only events, internal totals and hotel contacts never serialise to clients (V-8). 'Preview as client' is byte-identical to the real client response. Confirmed requires a done confirmed milestone and a signed contract; chargeable services wait for an active agreement.

nodes.label: AC-06: Engaged client receives correct project and permissions
nodes.rationale: Minimal-field project creation with code and back-fill; client roles and the finance flag shape the portal; membership scopes projects; removing a member ends access immediately; on-behalf decision requires evidence and is badged (P-9, V-14).

nodes.label: AC-07: Multiple functions with independent vendors, schedules, budgets, approvals
nodes.rationale: Approving one function's proposal leaves others untouched; budget totals per function and project; cancelling a function keeps its records (soft delete).

nodes.label: AC-08: Vendor shortlist permits fewer than five, does not require ten
nodes.rationale: Two or twelve options present cleanly; availability conflict warns but does not block; vendor internals never reach the client (V-8); on-behalf decisions badged.

nodes.label: AC-09: Approval refers to the exact version; revisions do not overwrite
nodes.rationale: A new version supersedes and the old one is immutable; approval locks the version and budget line; multiple approvers complete at required_decisions; internal comments hidden; approving an invitation does not send it.

nodes.label: AC-10: Self-service and assisted RSVP update the same database without duplicates
nodes.rationale: Self-service and AMPM-assisted RSVP write the same rows (unique upsert) so no duplicates arise. Per-side link tests activated (AC-10.11 to AC-10.13) and guest-edit-after-submission becomes a denial test; corrections go through the RSVP team (Q7). Identity capture conditional and safe; dietary required, allergies sensitive.

nodes.label: AC-11: Attendance changes update totals and flag downstream impacts
nodes.rationale: Totals and expected headcounts recalculate (guaranteed count unchanged); rooming and transfer changes flagged and logistics notified; recalculation is idempotent.

nodes.label: AC-12: Unauthorised users cannot reach restricted data by URL, API or file link
nodes.rationale: Verified by the generated authorisation suite plus identifier-tampering, signed-link expiry/binding, object-storage, class-filtered export and break-glass audit tests; denial semantics asserted exactly; no self-escalation of roles.

nodes.label: AC-13: Readiness cannot complete without checks or an authorised exception
nodes.rationale: An open required item blocks go-live (409); only Super Admin (Eva's authorised personnel) may authorise an exception — PM and HL attempts return 403 (Q10). Readiness derives automatically; the board works offline (V-4).

nodes.label: AC-14: Incidents can be assigned, escalated and closed with resolution notes
nodes.rationale: Report/assign; critical incidents escalate automatically on a timer; critical resolution requires notes; client visibility off by default; offline incident report queues and syncs.

nodes.label: AC-15: Closure checks departures, lost-and-found, vendor completion, reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Each closure item verified against data (409 until satisfied); access window of three months then memberships removed and archive on SA approval; reopening is Super Admin only. Retention after closure requires approval — the job proposes, nothing deleted until SA approves (Q8, Q17).

nodes.label: AC-16: Responsive and accessible interfaces
nodes.rationale: Three-width rendering, axe-core WCAG 2.1 AA, manual keyboard/screen-reader pass of the guest wizard, language switch with English fallback.

nodes.label: AC-17: Secure authentication
nodes.rationale: Staff authenticator mandatory; client/prospect mobile-OTP sign-in (Q13, AC-17.9); single-use time-boxed reset/invitation tokens; session timeouts and revocation; Argon2id storage; guest sessions bound to the household token.

nodes.label: AC-18: Server-side validation on every protected request
nodes.rationale: API integration suite generated from field-matrix.csv; field-matrix validations, required-at-stage rules, unknown-field/mass-assignment protection, duplicate-key uniqueness.

nodes.label: AC-19: Encryption in transit and at rest
nodes.rationale: TLS 1.2+ with HSTS; database/storage/volumes/backups encrypted with three customer-managed keys (restricted bucket its own key); no secrets in code, images or logs.

nodes.label: AC-20: Private file storage, expiring links, safe uploads
nodes.rationale: Upload type/size limits; antivirus scan; image metadata stripping; access follows the owning record. Expiring-link behaviour covered by AC-12.4 and AC-12.5.

nodes.label: AC-21: Audit trail
nodes.rationale: Every listed action writes one audit event with actor, entity, before/after (secrets masked); audit_events append-only at the database level; scoped audit viewer; monthly partitioning.

nodes.label: AC-22: Backups and tested restoration
nodes.rationale: Point-in-time restore drill (monthly pgBackRest rehearsal into staging, quarterly rebuild) measuring RPO 15 min / RTO 4 h (V-13); object-storage restore; backup-failure alerts. Phase 5 exit gate then quarterly.

nodes.label: AC-23: Search, filters, pagination and bulk operations
nodes.rationale: Stable server-side keyset pagination; combinable filters; bulk operations as one job with per-row audit; trigram hotel search relevance.

nodes.label: AC-24: Media optimisation and controlled video delivery
nodes.rationale: Image derivatives; video transcoded and served with expiring signed tokens; rights-gate visibility (consent required); media never appears outside its visibility level.

nodes.label: AC-25: Configurable packages, categories, statuses and pricing
nodes.rationale: Reference-data edits take effect without a deploy; thresholds drive automation (material-change %); checklist templates; no commercial literal in code (CI static check). No CMS/website editing in the current release (Q12).

nodes.label: AC-26: Clear errors, duplicate-submission prevention and form recovery
nodes.rationale: Idempotency keys make a double submission create one record; draft recovery after refresh; errors name the field, keep input and are announced to assistive technology.

nodes.label: AC-27: Retention, deletion and privacy
nodes.rationale: No automatic deletion; retention jobs propose, Super Admin approves (Q17). Consent captured with notice version; data-principal export/erasure; breach runbook drill; logs contain no personal data.

nodes.label: AC-28: Integration boundaries
nodes.rationale: Contract tests for payment, email, WhatsApp/SMS adapters against provider sandboxes; graceful degradation on outage; minimum data crossing (no restricted/sensitive/identity data to any provider).

nodes.label: AC-29: Notifications and automation
nodes.rationale: Approval requests notify approvers only; material changes create review tasks (Flow 6); overdue surfacing by role; complete notification log; preferences and WhatsApp opt-in honoured (U-10).

nodes.label: AC-30: Reports and exports
nodes.rationale: Every SPEC §9 report exists and computes from the seed; report permissions per permission-matrix §5.16; rooming-list export for hotels carries names, dates and category only, audited.

nodes.label: AC-31: Status transitions and guards
nodes.rationale: Transition tests generated from permission-matrix §7: listed principals succeed, unlisted get 403, unlisted transitions 409 with the guard message; status labels are display-only keys.

nodes.label: AC-32: Entitlement resolution and downgrades
nodes.rationale: Each account state yields the documented module set (generated from permission-matrix §3); downgrade is read-only before removal (nothing deleted); entitlement cache invalidates on write.

nodes.label: AC-33: Offline behaviour on event day
nodes.rationale: Offline moved to the first release and run on native builds (V-4 changed by Q1): read caches, ordered mutation sync, conflict rules (server wins on status, notes last-writer-wins), encrypted local store wiped on sign-out (AC-33.5/33.6).

nodes.label: AC-34: Performance and capacity
nodes.rationale: k6 load profiles rescaled to ~200 hotels and 20-40 weddings, staff/guest numbers to confirm (V-5, Q15); hotel search/detail latency, RSVP burst, mixed workspace load, job throughput, database growth.

nodes.label: AC-35: Imports
nodes.rationale: Hotel import with validation report; guest import by client and by RSVP team (duplicates flagged not merged); import of sensitive/identity columns refused.

nodes.label: AC-36: Finance integrity
nodes.rationale: Client and internal amounts never mix; finance-leak tests assert absence of internal fields against the serialiser schema across screens, exports, notifications and APIs (V-8); approved amounts locked; refund/direction rules. GST-invoice tests dormant — AMPM does not issue GST invoices from the platform (Q16).

nodes.label: AC-37: Live chat alongside tracked requests
nodes.rationale: New criterion from AMPM's live-chat decision (Q20): real-time client conversation reaches staff, a message can become a tracked request following Flow 6, chat never carries an approval, conversations are isolated, unanswered conversations surface.

nodes.label: AC-38: Department-based access
nodes.rationale: New criterion from AMPM's department-based access decision (Q6): a department sees only its own sections, project membership bounds every department, cost-field visibility limited to roles AMPM confirms (to be finalised).

nodes.label: Generated authorisation and validation test suites
nodes.rationale: Two suites generated from the permission matrix (§5, §6, §7) and field-matrix.csv (V-16, §8): a matrix/field change without a matching code change, or a code change widening access without a matrix change, fails the build. Keeps documents and code honest.

nodes.label: Synthetic test seed and fixtures
nodes.rationale: One idempotent synthetic seed (§7) shared by every suite: users per role, plans, 500 hotels (12 curated), sample wedding AMPM-2027-014 with 168 households and 412 guests, vendors, documents/media, configuration. No real names, numbers, addresses or images; staging never holds real guest data (V-15).

nodes.label: Phase exit packs
nodes.rationale: Five phases (Foundation, Wedding planning, Guest operations, Live execution, Stabilisation) from SPEC §11; each phase exit requires its criteria's P1/P2 tests to pass; AC-22 restore drill and full load/security are Phase 5 gates. Scope follows the first-release scope (V-11).

nodes.label: Denial semantics (404/403/400/409)
nodes.rationale: Architecture §6 convention asserted exactly by tests: a principal that may not see a record gets 404 (identical body to a nonexistent record); a visible record with a forbidden action gets 403; validation failures 400 naming the field; status-transition violations 409 with the guard message.

hyperedges.label: Versioned approval pattern across vendor, design, menu and invitation
